[Problem]
For a positive integer \(n\), let \(H\) be the \(n\times n\) matrix with entries \(H_{ij}=\int_0^1 x^{i+j-2}\,dx\) for \(1\le i,j\le n\). Determine the \(j\)-th entry of the last row of \(H^{-1}\), as a function of \(n\) and \(j\), for \(1\le j\le n\).


Provide a complete, verifiable derivation. If you use tools, explain how the tool results support your reasoning. Give the final answer with \boxed{...} and write the entire response in English.
